claim: The Service Quotas default for Running On-Demand P instances is 0, and the quota is adjustable.

qualifiers.scope: per account, per Region; measured in vCPUs

evidence.quote: There are quotas for the number of running On-Demand Instances per AWS account per Region. On-Demand Instance quotas are managed in terms of the *number of virtual central processing units (vCPUs)* that your running On-Demand Instances are using, regardless of the instance type.
